experiment_plan.purpose: option-free semantic answer comparison of native video, LS, A06 and text-only on non-detail questions
experiment_plan.change: add LS to the prepared three-arm open-ended protocol; no memory algorithm changes
experiment_plan.native_control: all complete causal sampled pairs; not the same token budget as compressed-memory arms
experiment_plan.memory_budget: 4 recent raw pairs + 4 pair equivalents of history; at most 864 visual tokens and 8 nodes per bank
experiment_plan.shared_cost: LS and A06 share pair encoding; count it once for each standalone method, not twice in actual shared run

input_protocol.change: replace multiple-choice answers with option-free short descriptive answers
input_protocol.purpose: reduce option-position and distractor effects; compare semantic video understanding
input_protocol.sampling: full causal prefix at fixed rate
input_protocol.native_prefix: original full-context reader of all complete observed pairs; no external-memory compression
input_protocol.A06_full: single encoding per observed pair; bounded A06 recent plus compressed history
input_protocol.generation: greedy, fresh language state per answer, save full generated text and token IDs
input_protocol.output_truncation: record stop reason; retain truncated answer and inspect, never silently resubmit
input_protocol.manual_judge: Codex after generation, against original free-form references; no paid judge API
input_protocol.unknown_reference: flag pending verification with null score; do not convert label uncertainty into model error
input_protocol.resources: pending media preflight and measured pilot; no unreviewed auto submission
input_protocol.LS: single encoding per observed pair; four recent raw pairs plus bounded LS compressed history

reproducibility: This package reproduces score aggregation, not a fresh GPU generation run. Historical generation source identity is recorded in experiment_plan.
